wholePhysicalScope: National Park Service HABS MO-1104 measured site plan, main-floor plan and transverse section, tied to the Library of Congress survey coordinate.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the flared roof, porch galleries, chimney silhouette and limestone street wall.
limitations: The site bearing is taken from the north-oriented measured site plan. Historic millwork, weathering and the stone grade break are simplified to the available photographic and survey detail.
